findings.failure_path: The new retirement-retarget branch validates only scope.changed_paths. The adjacent existing fixture explicitly documents that this set omits deleted files. Retarget a third owner's pointers while deleting one of its reference files: every inspected file can reproduce successfully, and the early true result bypasses the existing identifier-rename branch's package-bijection protection.
findings.smallest_fix: Compare complete base/head package inventories before granting retirement-retarget status, rejecting additions, deletions, renames, and mode changes. Add a retirement-specific fixture combining a valid retarget with a reference deletion.

findings.failure_path: The collapse regex lacks identifier boundaries and operates on pre-existing successor mentions. With a verified retirement into product-rd-workflow, a third owner's text 'product-rd-workflow and product-rd-workflow-extra' can become 'product-rd-workflow-extra' and satisfy reproduction without replacing any retired identifier. This removes an owner handoff while claiming an evidence-free identifier rename.
findings.smallest_fix: Collapse only complete skill identifiers whose duplication was produced by the retirement rewrite; require an actual retired-identifier replacement. Add negative fixtures for longer-name prefixes and pre-existing successor repetitions.

findings.failure_path: A personal skill can legitimately declare name: go-microservice-architecture and contain references/architecture-playbook.md. Those two properties alone cause the installer to move the entire personal directory out of discovery. The fixtures preserve directories with missing metadata or a different declared name, but do not test this same-name personal skill.
findings.smallest_fix: Require package provenance, such as an installer ownership record or a recognized shipped-content fingerprint, before moving architecture directories. Preserve ambiguous directories and add a fixture with matching name and marker but personal contents.

findings.failure_path: The bounded packet omits the selected skill bodies except software-architecture, the migrated target files, and the underlying verification artifacts. Consequently, the required installed-skill lens application, actual preservation behind the parity retirement and moved-path mappings, and claimed routing results cannot be independently checked. Ledger statements and self-review claims do not close this evidence gap.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply frozen review context containing the selected skill texts, relevant migration targets and source comparisons, and routing results tied to this candidate.
